Name: Club
Description: A heavy wooden stick used for bludgeoning foes.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage. Features the Light property.

Name: Dagger
Description: A short, sharp blade versatile in close combat or thrown at a distance.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d4 Piercing damage. Features the Finesse, Light, and Thrown (range 20/60) properties.

Name: Greatclub
Description: A massive wooden club requiring two hands to swing effectively.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Bludgeoning damage. Features the Two-Handed property.

Name: Handaxe
Description: A small axe optimized for chopping wood or enemies, suitable for throwing.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Slashing damage. Features the Light and Thrown (range 20/60) properties.

Name: Javelin
Description: A light spear specifically balanced for throwing.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Piercing damage. Features the Thrown (range 30/120) property.

Name: Light Hammer
Description: A small forging hammer repurposed for quick martial strikes.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage. Features the Light and Thrown (range 20/60) properties.

Name: Mace
Description: A heavy metal head on a sturdy wooden or metal haft, designed to crush armor.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Quarterstaff
Description: A versatile wooden staff heavily favored by monks and spellcasters.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Bludgeoning damage. Features the Versatile (1d8) property.

Name: Sickle
Description: A curved agricultural blade capable of sweeping attacks.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d4 Slashing damage. Features the Light property.

Name: Spear
Description: A simple shaft with a pointed head, one of the most common and reliable weapons in the world.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Piercing damage. Features the Thrown (range 20/60) and Versatile (1d8) properties.

Name: Crossbow, Light
Description: A mechanical bow mounted on a stock, drawing string tension mechanically for powerful bolts.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 80/320), Loading, and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Dart
Description: A small, weighted projectile favored for stealthy, quick throws.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d4 Piercing damage. Features the Finesse and Thrown (range 20/60) properties.

Name: Shortbow
Description: A small, flexible bow suitable for firing from cover or on the move.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 80/320) and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Sling
Description: A simple leather pouch and cord used to hurl stones with lethal velocity.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage. Features the Ammunition (range 30/120) property.

Name: Battleaxe
Description: A heavy, wide-bladed axe capable of cleaving through tough hides and armor.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Slashing damage. Features the Versatile (1d10) property.

Name: Flail
Description: A spiked metal head attached to a handle by a chain, designed to wrap around shields.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Glaive
Description: A polearm featuring a single-edged blade on the end of a long staff.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d10 Slashing damage. Features the Heavy, Reach, and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Greataxe
Description: A massive axe built to maximize the force of a full-body swing.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d12 Slashing damage. Features the Heavy and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Greatsword
Description: An enormous two-handed sword known for wide, devastating arcs.
Combat Implications: Deals 2d6 Slashing damage. Features the Heavy and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Halberd
Description: A multi-faceted polearm combining an axe blade and a thrusting spike.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d10 Slashing damage. Features the Heavy, Reach, and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Lance
Description: A long, sturdy thrusting spear primarily designed for mounted cavalry charges.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d12 Piercing damage. Features the Reach and Special (disadvantage against targets within 5 feet) properties. Two-handed when not mounted.

Name: Longsword
Description: A balanced, double-edged blade symbolizing classic knighthood.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Slashing damage. Features the Versatile (1d10) property.

Name: Maul
Description: A colossal, two-handed sledgehammer designed to pulverize defenses.
Combat Implications: Deals 2d6 Bludgeoning damage. Features the Heavy and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Morningstar
Description: A vicious, spiked metal club.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Piercing damage.

Name: Pike
Description: An exceptionally long spear meant for holding off charging enemies or maintaining formations.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d10 Piercing damage. Features the Heavy, Reach, and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Rapier
Description: A slender, sharply pointed sword optimized for fast, precise thrusts.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Piercing damage. Features the Finesse property.

Name: Scimitar
Description: A curved sword balanced for sweeping slashes.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Slashing damage. Features the Finesse and Light properties.

Name: Shortsword
Description: A highly maneuverable thrusting blade commonly used by skirmishers and rogues.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Piercing damage. Features the Finesse and Light properties.

Name: Trident
Description: A three-pronged spear often associated with gladiators and aquatic combatants.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Piercing damage. Features the Thrown (range 20/60) and Versatile (1d8) properties.

Name: War Pick
Description: A heavy, sharp spike set onto a sturdy handle to punch through plate armor.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Piercing damage.

Name: Warhammer
Description: A heavy, balanced hammer favored by clerics, paladins, and dwarven warriors.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Bludgeoning damage. Features the Versatile (1d10) property.

Name: Whip
Description: A braided leather cord capable of striking from a distance with a cracking slash.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d4 Slashing damage. Features the Finesse and Reach properties.

Name: Blowgun
Description: A narrow tube used to silently fire small needles, often coated in poison.
Combat Implications: Deals 1 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 25/100) and Loading properties.

Name: Crossbow, Hand
Description: A miniature crossbow capable of being fired with one hand.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d6 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 30/120), Light, and Loading properties.

Name: Crossbow, Heavy
Description: A powerful, heavy arbalest capable of punching through armor at long ranges.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d10 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 100/400), Heavy, Loading, and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Longbow
Description: A tall bow offering supreme range and powerful piercing capability.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 150/600), Heavy, and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Musket
Description: An early long-barreled firearm offering high damage at significant range.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d12 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 40/120), Loading, and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Pistol
Description: A one-handed flintlock or matchlock firearm.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d10 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 30/90) and Loading properties.

Name: Boomerang
Description: A curved aerodynamic piece of wood that returns to the thrower on a miss.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage. Features the Thrown (range 60/120) property. If it misses, it returns to the thrower's hand.

Name: Double-Bladed Scimitar
Source: Eberron: Rising from the Last War
Description: A traditional elven weapon featuring curved blades at both ends of a central haft.
Combat Implications: Deals 2d4 Slashing damage. Features the Two-Handed and Special properties (allows a bonus action attack dealing 1d4 slashing damage).

Name: Yklwa
Description: A short-shafted spear with a broad, sword-like blade native to Chult.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d8 Piercing damage. Features the Thrown (range 10/30) property.

Name: Antimatter Rifle
Description: A highly advanced futuristic weapon utilizing devastating technological payloads.
Combat Implications: Deals 6d8 Necrotic damage. Features the Ammunition (range 120/360), Reload (2 shots), and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Laser Pistol
Description: A handheld energy weapon of futuristic origin.
Combat Implications: Deals 3d6 Radiant damage. Features the Ammunition (range 40/120) and Reload (50 shots) properties.

Name: Laser Rifle
Description: A two-handed futuristic energy weapon providing continuous long-range radiant blasts.
Combat Implications: Deals 3d8 Radiant damage. Features the Ammunition (range 100/300), Reload (30 shots), and Two-Handed properties.

Name: Ballista
Description: A massive, stationary crossbow typically mounted on walls or ships.
Combat Implications: Deals 3d10 Piercing damage. Takes one action to load, one to aim, and one to fire. Large object.

Name: Cannon
Description: A heavy artillery piece firing iron balls via black powder propulsion.
Combat Implications: Deals 8d10 Bludgeoning damage. Takes one action to load, one to aim, and one to fire. Large object.

Name: Mangonel
Description: A stone-throwing catapult mechanism for battering fortifications.
Combat Implications: Deals 5d10 Bludgeoning damage. Takes two actions to load, two to aim, and one to fire. Large object.

Name: Trebuchet
Description: A heavy counterweight siege engine capable of hurling boulders massive distances.
Combat Implications: Deals 8d10 Bludgeoning damage. Takes two actions to load, two to aim, and one to fire. Huge object.

Name: Blunderbuss
Description: A short, large-caliber firearm flared at the muzzle, firing scattered shots.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d10 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 15/60), Scatter, and Reload properties.

Name: Revolver
Description: An advanced sidearm with a revolving cylinder for multiple successive shots.
Combat Implications: Deals 2d8 Piercing damage. Features the Ammunition (range 40/120), Reload (6 shots), and Light properties.

Name: Cestus
Description: Leather hand wraps reinforced with metal plates or spikes for brawling.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage. Features the Light and Unarmed modifiers.

Name: Lucerne Hammer
Description: A polearm carrying a specialized hammer head with a prolonged spike.
Combat Implications: Deals 1d10 Piercing damage. Features the Heavy, Reach, and Two-Handed properties.
